sloka: पश्येदानीं जगच्चित्रमिमं विश्रवसः सुत ।इदं मुहूर्तं तिष्ठस्व दुर्लभं ते भविष्यति ।। ७.३४.९ ॥
transliteration: paśyedānīṁ jagaccitramimaṁ viśravasaḥ suta ।idaṁ muhūrtaṁ tiṣṭhasva durlabhaṁ te bhaviṣyati ।। 7.34.9 ॥

translations.english: O son of Vishravas, behold this wonder of the world now, and wait for a moment, for such an opportunity will be rare for you in the future.
